header.name: Vaibhav Goel
header.tagline: I build production-grade systems at the intersection of machine learning, distributed engineering, and frontend architecture.

projects.name: Agentic Ledger
projects.description: Four Phinite OS agents for small merchants: catch spoofed payments in under 200 ms and approve micro-loans from an LSTM revenue forecast.

projects.name: Physics-Augmented 1D-CNN
projects.description: Leakage-controlled benchmark of 1D-CNN bearing-fault classifiers on CWRU and Paderborn. The protocol, not the architecture, decides the score.

projects.name: Java-Safe C++
projects.description: From-scratch compiler and stack VM for a memory-safe C++ subset, with null, bounds and refcount checks injected into the bytecode.

projects.name: Audict
projects.description: Call-audit platform for QA teams: Whisper transcripts and Llama 3.3 scoring via Groq, with JWT-protected audio streaming.

projects.name: Little World
projects.description: A private photo journal for two. Offline-first on IndexedDB and synced between devices through a Google Drive you own.

projects.name: IoT Fire Detection
projects.description: ESP32-S3 sensor fusion and a Random Forest (94.9% test accuracy, 367k real readings) built to cut false fire alarms, with a live digital twin.
